articles.title: Arsenal's Max Dowman to miss three matches after red card appeal rejected
articles.summary: Arsenal's Max Dowman will miss three matches after an appeal against his sending-off during Tuesday's loss at Fleetwood is rejected.
articles.body:
Arsenal 's Max Dowman will miss three matches after an appeal against his sending-off during Tuesday's Carabao Cup loss at Fleetwood was rejected.

The 16-year-old midfielder was shown a straight red card in the 85th minute after reacting to a heavy challenge by Fleetwood's Harrison Neal.

Although Dowman did not fully kick out, his foot did make contact with Neal.

It was Dowman's second red card this month having also been sent off while representing England's Under-19s.

As Dowman left the field, Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta gave him a scathing look and made what appeared to be an angry comment to the young winger.

Arteta said after the game: "When we prepared the context of the match, we were very clear on the things to respect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate. It was very clear."

Dowman was dismissed for violent conduct, which according to the laws of the game is when a player "uses or attempts to use excessive force or brutality against an opponent when not challenging for the ball... regardless of whether contact is made".

The Gunners were already light on options on the wing as Bukayo Saka, Christos Tzolis and Noni Madueke are currently out injured.

Arteta's side return to Premier League action away to Liverpool on Sunday.

Dowman sees red as Arsenal dumped out, but did Arteta go too far?

articles.title: Mate se apodera del lateral derecho
articles.standfirst: El de Petra está aprovechando la lesión en el tobillo de Javi Boñar para rendir a buen nivel
articles.summary: El de Petra está aprovechando la lesión en el tobillo de Javi Boñar para rendir a buen nivel
articles.body: El Girona está en buena racha y los jugadores que van entrando en el equipo por orden de su técnico, Quique Álvarez, tienen más facilidades para rendir a gran nivel. Un claro ejemplo es el del lateral derecho Mateu Morey, conocido como Mate y fichado por el club catalán el pasado verano procedente del Mallorca, un rival directo en la lucha por el ascenso directo, por un traspaso simbólico de 150.000 euros. Le costó entrar al de Petra debido al buen despliegue, primero de Arnau, hasta que se fue al Valencia, después de Francés, que jugó algún partido de lateral derecho pese a que ahora lo hace en el eje de la defensa, y por último de Javi Boñar. El técnico del Girona ya dio la alternativa a Mate, al que tuvo de pequeño en las categorías inferiores del Barça, contra el Andorra, justo en el partido en el que Boñar, saliendo de refresco, acabó lesionado de cierta gravedad en el tobillo. El balear se ha quedado 'solo' para el lateral derecho, pero tiene claro que está ante su gran oportunidad de dar un paso adelante y ya no perder la posición. De hecho, en los dos primeros encuentros con Mate como titular, los blanquirrojos no han encajado ningún gol y han vencido al Andorra (2-0) y al Celta Fortuna (5-1). Además, el defensa dio una asistencia de gran calidad al espacio a Vanat para que el ucraniano batiera a Coke en el último encuentro y firmara su hat-trick particular: “Es muy competitivo, tiene un espíritu de equipo muy grande, y a nivel futbolístico nos da mucho. Es muy intenso y como lleva muchos años sin jugar con continuidad pese a no tener problemas físicos, necesita un proceso interno aunque ya nos está ayudando”, decía el técnico Quique Álvarez en la previa contra la Real Sociedad B, un duelo que se disputará en Zubieta el sábado a las 14:00 horas. El catalán lo tiene claro: “Es un jugador de equipo que hace mejores a sus compañeros, ojalá tuviéramos más como él”. El lateral es todo intensidad defensiva, pero también despliegue ofensivo cuando la ocasión lo requiere. Por delante suyo ya ha coincidido con Carles Pérez y Yáser Asprilla en el extremo, algo que lo frena a lo que excursiones se refiere pero que complementa de maravilla con 14 contribuciones defensivas, seis recuperaciones y un 70% de duelos con éxito. Nada mal.

articles.body: El Rayo- Athletic, suspendido el pasado 10 de octubre a causa del lanzamiento masivo de bolas de silicona cuando no se habían cumplido ni 15 minutos de juego en una protesta coordinada de la afición local contra la gestión del presidente Raúl Martín Presa, se reanudará el 9 de diciembre a las 20 horas. El encuentro se jugará a puerta cerrada y el Rayo correrá con los gastos a los que deba hacer frente el Athletic. El partido le caerá al conjunto madrileño entre los duelos que jugará de local ante el Levante y de visitante con el Villarreal. El encuadre para el Athletic se hará entre los partidos ante Real Madrid ( San Mamés) y Deportivo (Riazor). Los clubes valoraron jugar al día siguiente de la suspensión, pero no pudo darse por causas de seguridad ya que ese día había otras actividades con refuerzo policial en Madrid. El partido se ha fijado en la tercera fecha UEFA disponible: dejando la semana del 4 de noviembre para posibles contingentes con la Copa también quedaba libre el 25 de noviembre.

articles.title: El Barcelona cierra temporalmente la grada de animación
articles.standfirst: Por el gran número de expedientes que se ha abierto a sus miembros últimamente
articles.summary: Por el gran número de expedientes que se ha abierto a sus miembros últimamente
articles.body: La directiva del FC Barcelona ha decidido cerrar temporalmente la grada de animación, denominada actualmente Gol 1957, a raíz de los acontecimientos sucedidos en los últimos partidos. «La decisión responde a la sucesión de expedientes abiertos al club y a algunos de sus socios a raíz de conductas contrarias a los valores del deporte. Estos comportamientos exponen al club a sanciones económicas y al riesgo de cierre del estadio, además de perjudicar su imagen», señala la entidad en un comunicado. La grada permanecerá cerrada, de momento, para el partido de este sábado frente al Alavés. La intención del club es reunirse con los integrantes de los diversos grupos que la forman con el fin de «establecer los compromisos necesarios para preservar una animación apasionada y respetuosa, que contribuya a apoyar al equipo sin poner en riesgo el patrimonio ni la reputación del FC Barcelona». No hay que olvidar que ya ha sido identificado el socio que agredió a algunos jugadores del Real Madrid y que se encontraba en esa zona. Este se expone a una sanción de hasta 60.000 euros. Si las conversaciones con los grupos de la grada Gol 1957 llegan a buen puerto y se alcanzan los acuerdos necesarios, la intención del club es reabrirla para el partido de Champions del próximo martes, en el que el equipo de Flick se enfrentará al Aston Villa.

articles.title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end
articles.summary: The first tentative steps to end the 3pm television blackout in the UK have been taken by Scottish football as it seeks offers for the next broadcast cycle.
articles.body:
The first tentative steps to end the 3pm television blackout have been taken by Scottish football as it seeks offers for the next broadcast cycle.

The SPFL has said that it is "flexible about the number of games" that will form part of the new deal, which will kick in from the 2029-30 season.

BBC Sport understands this includes the possibility that broadcasters could bid to show all matches live - including those shown on a Saturday afternoon.

The SPFL has created a tender with the greatest flexibility on the basis that the broadcaster does not seek to impose Article 48 of the Uefa Statutes.

Article 48 allows leagues to set specific times when matches are banned from being shown live on television. It can only be enforced when 50% of matches in a country's top two divisions are played at the same time.

While other parts of Europe have experimented with a blackout, it is now only present in the UK between 2:45pm and 5:15pm on a Saturday.

Other leagues now tend to stagger kick-off times so the top divisions do not all play at the same time, meaning the blackout could not be applied.

In the UK, 3pm remains the traditional, default kick-off time for all leagues from the very top down through non-league.

It was introduced due to fears that televised games at 3pm could affect attendances, not just at the clubs involved but at those down the divisions too.

But as streaming has grown in popularity, critics have argued that it hinders the ability of clubs to exploit this revenue stream.

This is especially the case in the lower levels, which have had to adhere to the blackout and not show any of their games online.

The Cymru Premier, the top division of football in Wales which has a mixture of professional and semi-professional clubs, removed the blackout in the summer in favour of a streaming model for all matches.

In August, Premier League chief executive Richard Masters indicated the direction of travel was to end the blackout, but any decision would be 18 months away and taken in consultation with the EFL and the FA.

The upcoming broadcast cycle provides a unique opportunity for all leagues to come together and reach a consensus, as the rights deals for the Premier League, EFL and SPFL all end in 2028-29.

While the possibility to take all games is on the table in Scotland, it is by no means certain the option will be taken up.

Under the current terms, Sky Sports can show up to 60 Premiership matches a season, with Premier Sports showing up to 22.

In total, there are 228 games in the top flight, meaning only 36% of matches are shown live under the current broadcast deal.

The tender allows broadcasters to present any proposition for live coverage they see fit.

Any decision would then be up to the Premiership's 12 member clubs, with eight votes required to approve a deal.

Clubs could potentially opt to reject an offer which would include the Saturday 3pm games.

Scotland ending the 3pm blackout would not automatically mean English (plus Welsh clubs in the pyramid) and Northern Irish football follows suit.

articles.summary: Los de Josan Gonzalez ganaban 2-0 a los cuatro minutos, pero André Coelho lideró la remontada lusa
articles.body: ElPozo Murcia se complica la 'Main Round' de Roermond tras ser remontado por el Benfica (2-3) en el partido que les ha enfrentado hoy y ahora, las opciones de los de Josan González pasan por ganar al Hit de Kiev en el partido del sábado para conseguir su clasificación, lo que sería como segundos, salvo que el Benfica cayera ante el Tigers Roermond. El arranque del partido fue el soñado para ElPozo Murcia. En apenas cuatro minutos, Dener estrelló un balón en la madera y Ricardinho y Marcel pusieron al conjunto español con dos goles en ventaja. El buen juego murcianista sometía al equipo que ha acabado en las dos últimas temporadas en Portugal con la hegemonía del Sporting Clube: el Benfica. Cierto es que el conjunto luso necesitaba ganar el partido, ya que una derrota hoy le dejaba con pocas opciones de ser primero y segundo. Tardaron los de Cassiano Klein, pero ver un equipo en el que militan Pany Varela, Cleber, André Coelho, Artur es un argumento suficiente para no darse por vencido. La remontada portuguesa se fue cociendo a un fuego tan lento como efectivo. Primero, fue André Coelho el que recortó distancias, posteriormente fue Cleber el que llevó el partido en empate al descanso y, en la reanudación André Coelho culminaba la vuelta al partido firmando el doblete. El conjunto de Josan González lo intentó hasta la extenuación, pero los palos, la falta de acierto o Leo Gugiel evitaron el empate. articles.title: MLS Announces Schedule for 1st-Ever Sprint Season, Playoffs Ahead of Format Changes
articles.summary: Major League Soccer announced key details Thursday regarding the 2027 "Sprint Season."
articles.body:
Major League Soccer announced key details Thursday regarding the 2027 "Sprint Season."

The truncated campaign will see every team play 14 matches from Feb. 19 until the end of the regular season on May 8. That will be followed by the playoffs with eight teams from each conference qualifying for a single-elimination tournament, and the Eastern and Western Conference champions meeting for the MLS Cup on Memorial Day Weekend.

MLS is instituting the Sprint Season for 2027 so it can transition into a summer-to-spring schedule in 2027-28, much like the top European leagues.

The 2027 Sprint Season will begin with a meeting between Lionel Messi's Inter Miami and Cincinnati FC on Feb. 19, followed by 13 additional matches on Feb. 20 and 21.

Every match during the 2027 Sprint Season will stream on Apple TV, and it will see each team face the 13 other teams in their conference one time each.

The regular season will end with "Decision Day" on May 8, featuring every Eastern Conference team playing at 5 p.m. ET and every Western Conference team playing at 8 p.m. ET.

After the MLS playoffs conclude in May, teams will prepare for the 2027-28 MLS season, which is scheduled to run from July 2027 to April 2028 with the playoffs occurring in May 2028.

The current 2026 MLS season will end on Nov. 7 with the playoffs running from Nov. 18 through Dec. 18.

That means teams will only have a two-month offseason before starting the 2027 Sprint Season this coming February.

articles.title: Former Falcons, Hawaii and SMU coach June Jones dies at 73
articles.summary: Jones was the head coach of the Falcons for three seasons and is the winningest coach in Hawaii football history.
articles.body:
Longtime NFL and college football coach June Jones died Thursday. He was 73.

According to the Honolulu Star-Advertiser, Jones had entered hospice care two weeks ago.

Jones was a former NFL quarterback who was an early adopter of the run and shoot offense during his four-decade career at the college and professional levels. He was the head coach of the Atlanta Falcons from 1994 through 1996, before he was the head coach at Hawaii and SMU.

Jones became the head coach of the Falcons after serving as the team's offensive coordinator under Jerry Glanville. He then replaced Glanville, as the Falcons went 19-29 in his three seasons in charge. Atlanta made the playoffs in 1995 after going 9-7, but lost to the Green Bay Packers in the wild-card round. He was fired a year later after tension with quarterback Jeff George led to a 3-13 season.

After spending the 1997 season out of football, Jones became the quarterbacks coach of the San Diego Chargers. He then served as the team's interim coach for the final 10 games of the 1998 season after Kevin Gilbride was fired.

From there, Jones became the head coach at Hawaii and is the school's winningest coach. A former college and NFL quarterback, Jones had played two seasons for the Warriors in the 1970s.

Hawaii went 76-41 in Jones' time with the team and won at least 10 games in three of his nine seasons. In 2007, his final season at Hawaii, the Warriors went 12-0 in the regular season before losing to Georgia in the Sugar Bowl.

As Hawaii went undefeated, quarterback Colt Brennan was a Heisman finalist and set the career record for touchdown passes at the FBS level. Brennan threw 38 TDs in 2007 after throwing 58 touchdowns in 2006.

Jones left Hawaii for SMU, where he coached for six full seasons. The Mustangs were 36-43 with Jones as the head coach. Jones' tenure ended two games into the 2014 season as he cited personal issues for his decision to step down.

SMU, which had moved to the American Conference from Conference USA in 2013 and is now a part of the ACC, went on to finish 1-11 after Jones' resignation.

Jones continued to coach after stepping down from SMU. He coached high school football in Hawaii before coaching in the CFL, the reincarnated XFL and the short-lived "The Spring League." Jones' last major coaching job came in 2023, when he was the offensive coordinator for the XFL's Seattle Sea Dragons.

After playing quarterback for run and shoot pioneer Mouse Davis at Portland State, Jones helped Davis bring the offensive system into the mainstream. The run and shoot offense popularized the idea of a pass-first offense with receivers running option routes based on where opposing defenses placed their coverages.

Jones was the quarterbacks coach for the Detroit Lions in 1989 and 1990 as Davis was the team's offensive coordinator. Davis later coached under Jones for the Falcons and at Hawaii.

Before he got into coaching in 1983, Jones was a quarterback for the Falcons for four seasons and spent another season in the CFL. Across his time in the NFL, Jones appeared in 17 games and made five starts for the Falcons over the 1978 and 1979 seasons. He finished his career 75-of-166 passing for 923 yards with three touchdowns and seven interceptions.

articles.title: Kumbulla se 'presenta' a lo grande: "Cuando me necesite el míster, estaré preparado"
articles.standfirst: El defensa albano fue de lo más destacado del partido ante el Recreativo
articles.summary: El defensa albano fue de lo más destacado del partido ante el Recreativo
articles.body: Marash Kumbulla ha puesto en un 'aprieto' a Beñat San José. Cuando parecía que la pareja de centrales estaba definida por la elección de Lejeune y Mujaid, va el albano y se marca un gran partido ante el Recreativo de Huelva. Fue el último de los fichajes en debutar y dejó muy buenas impresiones. Disputó 80 minutos en los que se mostró fiable en defensa y fue determinante en ataque. Kumbulla mostró sus mejores cualidades en el Nuevo Colombino. Sirvió como enlace entre la defensa y la delantera y en total realizó cinco contribuciones defensivas y ganó todos sus duelos (5/5). Además, en una de sus carreras para sacar el balón, se acabó internando en ataque y consiguió provocar el penalti que convirtió Alemao para hacer el empate a uno. Al término del encuentro, Kumbulla se mostró muy contento con la actuación colectiva.“Estoy muy feliz por la victoria, que ha sido muy importante para pasar de ronda y seguir adelante en esta competición", comenzó para después hablar de su estado de forma. "Me siento muy bien físicamente y quiero darlo todo para alcanzar nuestros objetivos, porque nuestros aficionados se lo merecen. Estoy a plena disposición del míster y, cuando me necesite, estaré preparado”, sentenció. La pareja de centrales de Lejeune y Pathé Ciss fue la más usada la temporada pasada. Sin embargo, con los refuerzos de Mujaid y de Kumbulla, Beñat devolvió al senegalés a su posición natural y apostó por el central riojano en cinco encuentros. Tras el debut del albanés y los buenos minutos de Pelayo, el puesto en ese centro de la zaga está más caro que nunca.

articles.title: Milan e Inter desvelan su nuevo San Siro
articles.standfirst: Ambas entidades han presentado la que será su nueva casa... a partir de 2031
articles.summary: Ambas entidades han presentado la que será su nueva casa... a partir de 2031
articles.body: Milan e Inter llevan tiempo buscando fórmulas para dejar atrás el mítico San Siro. Hoy, después de una larga negociación que diferentes entidades, públicas y privadas, ambas 'squadras' han anunciado la que será su nueva casa. La presentación se ha llevado a cabo durante una rueda de prensa realizada en el Castillo Sforzesco de Milán... con la presencia de los presidentes de ambas entidades, Paolo Scaroni (Milan) y Giuseppe Marotta (Inter), además de los arquitectos Lord Norman Foster y David Manica. También estaban Beppe Sala (alcalde) y Attilio Fontana (gobernador). Ubicado en el parking del actual San Siro, la previsión es que las obras comiencen durante el segundo semestre de 2027 o, a mucho tardar, en el primero de 2028. La inauguración, sin embargo, está prevista para el arranque de la temporada 2031-32. Es decir, llegaría a tiempo para la Eurocopa. Mientras tanto, Milan e Inter continuarán disputando sus partidos en San Siro. Cabe recalcar, eso sí, que habrá un cambio significativo en el 'naming'. Para llevar a cabo este tipo de proyectos, es cuestión obligatoria obtener financiación externa y, en esta ocasión, será 'Generali', una de las grandes aseguradoras de Europa, quien patrocine el nombre de un estadio destinado a llevar a otra dimensión a Inter y Milan. Se espera que los ingresos aumenten en 120 millones de euros. El 'render' presentado es tremendamente llamativo. Con una capacidad estimada superior a los 71.500 espectadores, el diseño cuenta con una forma de cuenco y dos anillos con una inclinación de 37 grados que imitan al Signal Iduna Park. La fachada tendrá unos paneles LED e irán variando de color según jueguen Milan o Inter. Se estima que la inversión ronde los 2.200 millones de euros... incluyendo toda la reurbanización del área aledaña a San Siro.

articles.title: 2. Bundesliga preview: Energie Cottbus vs. VfL Bochum
articles.summary: Energie Cottbus welcome VfL Bochum to the LEAG Energie Stadion on Friday as the 2. Bundesliga's 10th matchday gets underway.The hosts are looking to end a ru...
articles.body:
Energie Cottbus welcome VfL Bochum to the LEAG Energie Stadion on Friday as the 2. Bundesliga's 10th matchday gets underway.

The hosts are looking to end a run of draws and secure their first league victory since beating Karlsruher SC 3-0 in September. Bochum, meanwhile, arrive encouraged by their recent performances, having drawn with Wolfsburg before eliminating Mainz from the DFB-Pokal.

With both sides seeking greater consistency, the encounter presents an opportunity to gain valuable points as the season progresses.

Claus-Dieter Wollitz's side return to home soil looking to end a frustrating run of results. Energie have collected 10 points from their opening nine league matches, recording two wins, four draws and three defeats since returning to the 2. Bundesliga after a 12-year absence.

The hosts have drawn their last two league fixtures 1-1 against 1. FC Nürnberg and Heidenheim, with their most recent victory coming in an impressive 3-0 away win over Karlsruher SC in September. Cottbus have also demonstrated their attacking potential in an extraordinary 4-4 draw against VfL Wolfsburg, having recovered from three goals behind.

However, their defensive record remains a concern, with 18 goals conceded across their first nine league matches. Against a Bochum side fresh from a confidence-boosting cup victory, Wollitz will need his players to combine their attacking ambition with greater defensive discipline.

The Cottbus coach is expecting a demanding encounter and believes his team must maintain their intensity throughout the contest. He has also acknowledged that Bochum's recent performances have improved, particularly following their draw against Wolfsburg and their DFB-Pokal victory over Mainz.

With the home crowd expected to provide a strong atmosphere under the floodlights, Energie will hope to turn their promising attacking displays into a much-needed three points.

VfL Bochum travel to Cottbus looking to build on a positive week under Uwe Rösler. After drawing 1-1 with Wolfsburg in the league, Bochum defeated Bundesliga opposition Mainz 2-0 in the second round of the DFB-Pokal on Tuesday.

The cup victory provides encouragement after a difficult start to their league campaign. Bochum have collected eight points from nine matches, leaving them 14th in the table and in need of a more consistent run of results.

Rösler has warned his players against underestimating the challenge posed by Cottbus, highlighting the hosts' intensity, pressing and attacking quality. The Bochum coach expects Energie to apply pressure from the opening whistle and attempt to disrupt his team's passing patterns.

The visitors must also manage the physical demands of playing three matches in a short period. Rösler acknowledged that the final game of an English week can be particularly challenging, but believes his side can compete if they reproduce the mentality shown against Wolfsburg and Mainz.

Bochum will therefore look to control possession, remain compact without the ball and exploit the spaces left by Cottbus' aggressive pressing. If they can navigate the opening stages successfully, their technical quality could prove decisive.

The two clubs have met 22 times in the Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga, with Bochum holding the advantage in the overall record. The visitors have won nine encounters, compared with six victories for Energie Cottbus, while seven matches have ended in draws.

Their most recent meeting came in April 2014, when Bochum recovered from a goal behind at half-time to claim a 2-1 victory. The reverse fixture earlier in the 2013/14 season also ended in a Bochum win, with the visitors securing a 1-0 victory in Cottbus.

Bochum have gone unbeaten in their last five meetings with Energie, with their most recent defeat against the Lausitz club dating back to November 2011.

The historical record therefore favours the visitors, although the long gap since their last meeting means Friday's fixture will be a different challenge. Cottbus' return to the second tier and their energetic approach under Wollitz could make this a far more competitive encounter than previous results might suggest.

Wollitz could welcome several important players back into contention after a difficult period with injuries and illness.

Justin Butler, Leonardo Bittencourt and Moritz Hannemann all returned to training during the week after missing the 1-1 draw against Heidenheim. Butler has scored five league goals this season, making his potential return particularly significant for Cottbus' attacking prospects.

Jonas Hofmann and Julian Guttau have also resumed training, although their availability remains subject to a late assessment. Guttau has completed a full week of training following a lengthy absence caused by a partial tear of the plantar fascia.

Captain Axel Borgmann remains unavailable with thigh problems, with his return expected for the subsequent fixture against Eintracht Braunschweig. Erik Engelhardt also remains sidelined with a cruciate ligament injury.

Bochum have several established absentees, including Babis Drakas, Jean-Manuel Mbom, Oliver Olsen and Philipp Strompf.

Christian Rasmussen and Maximilian Wittek were both forced off with injuries during the DFB-Pokal victory over Mainz. However, Rösler reported that both players were making progress and were likely to travel with the squad to Cottbus, although their final availability remained uncertain ahead of Friday's match.

The coach will also have to consider the physical condition of his players after the demanding schedule. With three matches in a short period, rotation could be a factor, particularly if either Rasmussen or Wittek is unable to start.

Energie Cottbus (4-2-3-1): Lotka; Rorig, Manu, Campulka, Guwara; Michelbrink, Bittencourt; Cigerci, Copado, Hannemann; Butler

VfL Bochum (4-2-3-1): Horn; Klaiber, Steinwender, Mets, Wittek; Meyer, Pannewig; Holtmann, Taz, Miyoshi; Hofmann.

articles.body:
Jack Grealish was dropped for Everton's League Cup fourth round clash against Newcastle on Thursday after "a breach of club discipline".

It was reported that the breach related to Grealish's unauthorised absence from training.

The 31-year-old missed Saturday's 2-0 loss at Arsenal in the Premier League due to an illness.

Grealish, who is on a second season-long loan from Manchester City, had started Everton's three Premier League matches prior to their defeat against champions Arsenal.

The 31-year-old has made six appearances for David Moyes's side this term, most recently in their loss against Chelsea on October 17.

Grealish has been dogged by criticism of his off-pitch behaviour for several years amid reports of nightclub incidents that saw him fall out of favour at City.

After playing a key role in City's treble-winning campaign in 2022-23, Grealish became an increasingly sidelined figure at the Etihad Stadium.

Everton are facing Newcastle for a place in the League Cup quarter-finals, with Fleetwood awaiting the winner after their shock victory over Arsenal on Tuesday.
